## Executive Summary
Nimbus Pro is recommended for mid-size and larger teams needing governance controls.

## Product Comparison
Nimbus Core suits small teams of 2-15 people [product-a]. Nimbus Pro targets organizations above 200 employees with RBAC and SSO [product-b].

## Pricing
Nimbus Core costs $9/seat/month with no minimum [pricing]. Nimbus Pro costs $34/seat/month billed annually with a 50-seat minimum [pricing].

## Security
Nimbus Core has no independent compliance certification [security]. Nimbus Pro is SOC 2 Type II certified with a 7-year audit log [security].

## Recommendation
We recommend Nimbus Pro for teams requiring governance and compliance controls.

# Nimbus Core (product-a)

**Doc ID:** `product-a`
**Classification:** approved

Nimbus Core is a lightweight project-tracking tool aimed at small teams
(2-15 people). It ships with kanban boards, a single shared workspace, and
email notifications. There is no role-based access control; every team
member has full edit access to every board.

Nimbus Core is priced for simplicity, not depth: it intentionally omits
enterprise controls such as audit logging, SSO, or data residency options.

steps.name: read_artifact
steps.result:
# Nimbus Pro (product-b)

**Doc ID:** `product-b`
**Classification:** approved

Nimbus Pro is the enterprise edition of the Nimbus platform, built for
organizations above 200 employees. It adds role-based access control,
SSO (SAML/OIDC), per-workspace data residency, and a full audit log of
every board and card change.

Nimbus Pro requires a dedicated workspace administrator and a minimum
12-month commitment.

# Pricing (pricing)

**Doc ID:** `pricing`
**Classification:** approved

- Nimbus Core: $9 per seat / month, billed monthly, no minimum seats.
- Nimbus Pro: $34 per seat / month, billed annually, 50-seat minimum.
- Nimbus Pro includes one dedicated customer success contact.
- Discounts beyond published list price require a signed enterprise
  agreement; no informal or unpublished discount programs exist.

steps.name: read_artifact

# Security (security)

**Doc ID:** `security`
**Classification:** approved

- Nimbus Core: data encrypted at rest and in transit; single-region
  hosting only; no independent compliance certification.
- Nimbus Pro: SOC 2 Type II certified; supports customer-chosen data
  residency region; SSO required for all users; full audit log retained
  for 7 years.
